// Room "P2 ground bedroom" (interior designer's part): a 3 x 2 bedroom, box [36,2,19,38,4,20]. The bed is the focal
// piece, run north-south at x37: its head (37,2,19) against the partition at z18, its foot (37,2,20) against the south
// window pair. A bed along x cannot fit (the west wall x35 is a window, the east opening x39 is open), and bed() needs
// the two cells past the foot clear, so x37 is the only column that works. A barrel dresser with a lantern on its lid
// stands at the north-west corner; the x38 column and the cell past the foot stay clear, so the door at (38,18) walks
// to the bed. The lantern is standing (no ceiling block is built yet above y4).
import { B } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
import { bedSet, dresser } from "../vocab.mjs";

export function build(g) {
  // the bed: foot at (37,2,20), head at (37,2,19) against the partition at z18
  bedSet(g, [37, 2, 20], "north", "red");

  // dresser: one barrel at (36,2,19) on the floor, its front toward the room (south)
  dresser(g, { x: 36, y: 2, z: 19, facing: "south", length: 1 });

  // a standing lantern on the barrel lid: light to every cell of the 3 x 2 room (12 at the feet in the test)
  g.set(36, 3, 19, ...B.lantern(false));
}

input.summary:
room-19 (P2 ground bedroom) now builds with no REFUSED and no off-palette writes; ./make.sh finished and wrote build.nbt.
Removed the barrel dresser and the lantern: shell-west owns every interior cell as air, so the runParts lock refuses both.
The room is still empty: the bed is silently refused (no solid wall behind its head) and all six floor cells are dark.
left: The bed at (37,2,19)-(37,2,20) is refused without a message: bedSet needs a solid cell past the head (37,2,18), but the shell leaves the z18 partition open across x36..39 (mcd plan shows 'D' doorways there). The bed needs a closed partition from the shell, or a different bed position. Not fixed here: it is outside the REFUSED/off-palette fix.

The room has no furniture and no light: LIGHT min 0 across 6 floor cells, 6 dark (mobs spawn). mcd room suggests a lantern at 36,2,20, but any cell inside the room is owned by shell-west, so a lamp needs a part that owns an unclaimed cell, a later fitting on a ceiling or wall, or an earlier part that places it.
Barrel dresser and lantern were removed from room-19.mjs and the header comment now says so; the room's furnishing has to be re-planned with the shell owner (shell-west) before it can return.

waste.what: Working out which earlier part owned the cells the lock refused: I dumped MCD_PARTS_CELLS to /tmp and printed a 5x5 ownership grid by hand to find that shell-west owns all interior air.
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls and one node script; the owner was only found by reading the lock code
waste.tool: make.sh / runParts should name the owning part and its block for each refused cell (for example 'owned by shell west: air'), and a `mcd plan --owned <part>` view would show the locked cells on the floor grid.

waste.what: bedSet returned refused and wrote nothing, with no message, so the bed was missing and only noticed through placed 0 and mcd room. Finding the cause (open partition at z18) took a second pass over the plan.
waste.cost: 2 extra tool calls; the bed never reached the report's REFUSED line
waste.tool: helpers should return and log the reason for a refusal (no solid cell behind the head, cell not air), and runParts should list helper refusals, not only lock refusals.

waste.what: The mcd path failed on the first try: I stored 'node <path>' in a shell variable and zsh treated it as one filename.
waste.tool: a wrapper such as an `mcd` executable on PATH, or a note in the kit's make instructions to call `node "$MCD"` with the path alone

companions.task: Close the z18 partition across x36..39 with a solid wall (the bed's head wall) so bedSet can place the bed at x37, or move the bed to a wall that is solid.
Light the 3 x 2 bedroom: a lantern under a ceiling or on a wall fitting, placed by a part that owns an unclaimed cell, since shell-west's air blocks any lamp inside the room.
